summary: Independent review reproduced the original worker-death and queue-stall failure on the exact recorded base. At the exact candidate commit, both backup workers catch ordinary backend exceptions, acknowledge failed operations with distinct exception type/message metadata, retain partial-progress accounting, and continue draining subsequent work. False-return and hybrid sidecar failure metadata also passed the focused regression suite. No source or native files were changed by this review.

tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed the expected failing-before state: RuntimeError terminated HiCacheController.backup_thread_func, zero operations were acknowledged, and one operation remained queued.

Candidate regression suite: 7 passed, covering worker survival/draining, distinct exception details, partial progress, backend false returns, clean success/skip state, hybrid exception acknowledgement, and hybrid sidecar partial failure.
Both standard and hybrid workers distinguished TimeoutError('remote timed out') from ValueError('malformed response'), acknowledged both failures, and processed a following success.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-955544668865/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' ... independent actual _page_backup batching checks ... PY (candidate c2d4590aadb34914e913103c2e49a2b5c40bc09f)
tests.what_was_measured: Independent adversarial cases used the real HiCacheController._page_backup path: a timeout after 128 of 129 pages yielded completed_tokens=2048 and unwritten_pages=1 while the following operation completed; a False return yielded backend_false with two unwritten pages and the following operation completed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reported defect is CPU-only Python thread/queue/error-metadata behavior. The prepared interpreter has torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but GPU execution would not exercise the contract and was not claimed.

remaining_limitations: No real remote storage service was disrupted; deterministic injected timeout, malformed-response, and false-return behavior exercised the production worker and page-backup methods.
No model-serving, model-architecture, semantic-accuracy, GPU-kernel, or distributed-workload claim is made.
No native code changed between the recorded base and candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
